description: This file defines a utility function `getPlaintextFontSize` that maps font size enum values to corresponding CSS class strings based on the device's screen type (mobile, tablet, or desktop). It imports screen size detection functions and an enum for font sizes, then uses conditional logic to determine the appropriate class string.

methods.name: getPlaintextFontSize
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string for a given font size key, adjusted for device screen size (mobile, tablet, or desktop).
